verdict.rationale: SerpApi is API-first: its core function, scraping and parsing search results across many engines, is delivered through the API. The API also covers the surrounding search workflow: location lookup, async submission, retrieval via the Searches Archive API, cached results, and json/html/md output with field selection. There is also an official MCP server and llms.txt for agent access. Missing for 10: no evidence that account-level settings (ZeroTrace Mode, Automatic Early Renewal, plan/billing) can be managed via API; no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404s); no independent confirmation of full UI/API parity.
